changes.now: With Electro's help, Doctor Octopus breaks himself, the Vulture, the Sandman and the Rhino out of prison, and with the Shocker they form the Sinister Six to take revenge on Spider-Man.
changes.proposed: With Electro's help, Doctor Octopus breaks himself, the Vulture, the Shocker, the Sandman and the Rhino out of prison, and they form the Sinister Six to take revenge on Spider-Man.
changes.evidence: In Group Therapy, Doctor Octopus (with Electro) breaks the Vulture, the Shocker, the Sandman and the Rhino out of Ryker's Island together; the Shocker is one of the inmates freed, not a separate later recruit as the current wording implies.

owner_calls.question: The where fields use the wiki designations Earth-1610B, Earth-65B and Earth-50101B, but on screen in Across the Spider-Verse the worlds are labelled Earth-1610, Earth-65 and Earth-50101 (the B suffix is a fan wiki convention to tell the film worlds from the comics). Keep the B suffix as the app convention, or use the on-screen designations?
options: Keep Earth-1610B / Earth-65B / Earth-50101B (app convention, like other wiki designations)
Use the on-screen Earth-1610 / Earth-65 / Earth-50101
owner_calls.evidence: Wikipedia plot of Across the Spider-Verse: "On Earth-65, Spider-Woman Gwen Stacy...", "On Earth-1610, 16 months after...", "the next universe: Earth-50101"; the spiderman.fandom page titles use Earth-1610B.
